# Haki tree techniques

[Training and Haki rules](haki.md)

Each row gives the mastery shown in the branch. Techniques can also have Doriki and Haki prerequisites. Fruit users cannot exceed 52 mastery in a branch under the supplied settings. Forks and keystones offer two choices.
